page.title: Receipt
page.purpose: Show every step a document passed through and where each one executed, so a user can check the residency claim rather than take it on trust — and export that record as the artifact a compliance reviewer accepts.

priorities.statement: The boundary between local and remote execution is the loudest thing on the page.
priorities.notes: A reader scanning the timeline should be able to answer 'did anything leave this machine' in one pass, without reading a single row in detail.

priorities.statement: Copy states checkable facts, not reassurance.
priorities.notes: '0 bytes left this machine' beside a link to the evidence, never 'your data is safe'. The claim is falsifiable and the page should invite checking.

priorities.statement: A blocked route reads as the guarantee working, not as an error to route around.
priorities.notes: When a confidential document is refused a remote provider, that is OT-P0-013 behaving correctly. Presenting it as a failure would teach users to disable it.

priorities.statement: The record is visibly append-only, including after the document is deleted.
Export produces the same content the screen shows.

states.description: The full step timeline is shown with each step's locality.
Custody records are still in flight.
Every step executed locally; the page states this as its headline fact.
At least one step executed remotely and the boundary is explicitly marked.
A step was refused a remote provider because of the document's privacy class.
The document has been deleted; the custody trail remains and says so.
Custody records could not be loaded and the reason is visible.

elements.name: Processing steps
elements.description: One entry per derivation and inference step: tier, provider, locality, profile, privacy class, duration, credits.

elements.name: Residency summary
elements.description: The headline fact — whether anything left this machine.

claims.statement: The receipt page exposes a named region containing the step timeline.
Every step in the timeline states where it executed; no step renders without a locality.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-014. A step with unknown locality silently voids the whole record, so a missing value must be visible rather than blank.

claims.statement: The residency summary is the visually dominant element on the page.
The local-versus-remote boundary is conveyed by text and position as well as color.
claims.rationale: The distinction this page exists to communicate must not depend on color perception.

claims.statement: A route refused because of privacy class is presented as the policy working, not as an error.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-013. If this reads as a failure, operators will look for a way to disable the guarantee, which is the opposite of the intent.

claims.statement: A deleted document's receipt still renders and says the document was deleted.
While AI Gateway route evidence carries no caller correlation key, the export states that the record is self-attested.
claims.rationale: Claiming independent corroboration we cannot currently produce would be the one thing that discredits the whole product. Remove this claim when the gateway gap closes.

claims.statement: Loading, all-local, mixed, blocked, tombstoned and error states are reachable and distinct.
The timeline and the export action are reachable by keyboard alone.
